en.question:
If a monster's name is treated as "Unknown", such as by the effects of <<21183>> or <<21193>>, can I declare "Unknown" when activating <<14313>>?

Furthermore, if there are no monsters whose names are currently treated as "Unknown", can I still activate <<14313>> by declaring "Unknown"?
en.title: When I declare a card name (such as for <<14313>>), can I declare "Unknown"?

ja.question:

また、カード名を「アンノウン」として扱われているモンスターが存在しない場合、「<<14313>>」を発動する際に「アンノウン」をカード名として宣言することはできますか？
